ActiveDeviceSession.title: ActiveDeviceSession
ActiveDeviceSession.description: Represents an authenticated user's active device login session synchronized across devices via Firebase Firestore.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user owning this session.

deviceName.description: Display name of the device (e.g., Pixel 8, Home Desktop PC).

platform.description: Operating system / platform (e.g., Android 15, Windows 11, macOS).

clientType.description: Client application or browser holding the session.

ipAddress.description: Observed LAN or WAN IP address of the device session.

locationSource.description: Source used to resolve device coordinates and city.

locationAddress.description: Human-readable city/country location of the session.

charging.description: Whether the device is currently charging or AC powered.

online.description: Whether the session is currently active/online.

aegisGuardInstalled.description: Whether the AegisGuard app is running on this device.

trackingMode.description: Tracking protocol used for the session.

pairedToken.description: Optional AegisGuard P2P cryptographic pairing token.

lockedRemotely.description: Whether remote anti-theft lockdown has been triggered for this session.

signedOutRemotely.description: Whether this device session has been remotely terminated.

networkCarrierOrWifi.description: Active network interface, Wi-Fi, or WAN link label.

lastSeenAtMillis.description: Last local heartbeat timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

DeviceLocationHistory.title: DeviceLocationHistory
DeviceLocationHistory.description: Immutable per-device location check-in record stored under the authenticated user's locationHistory subcollection.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

deviceId.description: Session or node identifier of the device.

deviceName.description: Human-readable name of the tracked device.

locationAddress.description: Resolved neighborhood, city, and country address.

locationSource.description: Telemetry method used (GPS, IP Geolocation, Timezone, Per-Device Calibration).

recordedAtMillis.description: Client check-in timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

eventNote.description: Short description of why this checkpoint was logged.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SessionLocationPoint.title: SessionLocationPoint
SessionLocationPoint.description: Per-session geocoordinate fix with timestamp and horizontal/vertical accuracy metadata stored under each active session.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this session.

sessionId.description: Session document ID this coordinate fix belongs to.

deviceName.description: Human-readable device label for this session.

locationAddress.description: Resolved neighborhood, city, and country label.

eventNote.description: Audit note explaining trigger for this coordinate fix.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: User-scoped active login sessions across mobile and desktop devices synced via Firebase Session Manager.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}/loc.description: Per-session geocoordinate fixes with specific capture timestamps and accuracy metadata.

/users/{userId}/locationHistory/{entryId.description: User-scoped immutable timeline of per-device location check-ins and calibrations.
